descriptionChirho: To actively search out, examine, or inspect something or someone (Piel stem); involves physical or administrative investigation, as in searching for sheep (Ezek 34:11-12) or examining offerings (Lev 13:36, 27:33).
To inquire or seek information through consultation (Piel infinitive construct with lamed); used of seeking God's will or consulting an oracle (2 Kgs 16:15, Eccl 7:25).
To consider or ponder mentally, reflecting on a matter with careful thought (Piel infinitive construct); a cognitive rather than physical searching (Prov 20:25).
